quarterly_data.signal: Directors (as advised to the independent financial adviser, in the company's shareholder circular): the estimated second-half 2026 API service amounts reflect the anticipated launch of an updated version of the company's existing foundation model suite during July-December 2026, expected to sharply increase income from business-to-business customers; after the launch of an updated model suite in 2025, the company recorded an increase of 80% to 90% in average income from business-to-business customers for the next two months compared with the previous month. The directors also expect cloud services expenses to be almost all part of the expenses of the company's AI infrastructure and model R&D.
